rows.description: a slender wooden arrow, silver sharp arrowhead, pale feather fletching fluttering subtly, a short faint speed streak behind it
a barbed wooden arrow with a bright green tip, two small vines fluttering backward along its shaft, a green trailing wisp
a massive long golden arrow with a thick shaft and oversized broad spear arrowhead, bold gold feathers, a long blazing golden trail behind it; much larger and thicker than every other arrow
a real straight silver tipped arrow with dark shaft and white feathers, fluttering fletching and a very short pale speed streak; this arrow will be rotated downwards by the game
a small corked round amber glass potion bottle tumbling end over end, filled with golden light; four rotations 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees with tiny gold droplets behind
a slender corked white gold sacred potion vial tumbling end over end; four rotations 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees with small pale golden sparks
a pointed knotted thorn pod dart with dark wood and lime green barbs, thorn vine tendrils wriggling behind it
one long sharp wooden thorn spike, ivory pointed tip, tiny green leaves and a short green trail fluttering behind
a real slender steel throwing dagger, pointed blade forward, dark purple wrapped handle behind, bright glint shifting along the blade
